name: Ratio Covered Call Write
summary: Own 100 shares and sell 2 or more calls against them. The extra call is NAKED. Included for completeness; not permitted at Level 3.

legs.strike_rule: Delta 0.25-0.35; one call is covered by the shares, the second is uncovered

max_profit: (strike - cost basis + 2 x credit) x 100 at the strike
max_loss: UNDEFINED to the upside. Above the strike the uncovered second call loses without limit: the loss grows by $100 per $1 of underlying advance beyond the upper breakeven, forever.
breakevens: Upside: strike + (strike - cost basis + 2 x credit). Downside: cost basis - 2 x credit

greeks.delta: +100 minus 50-70 = +30 to +50, turning negative as price rises
greeks.theta: positive, roughly double a single covered call

when_to_use: Never in this account. Documented so the automation recognises the structure and refuses it. Historically used by market makers and floor traders with continuous hedging ability.
entry_rules: BLOCKED: requires Level 4 (uncovered short call). This account is Level 3, and Alpaca's approval tiers run 1 through 3 only - Level 4 is not offered at all, so the order will be rejected by the broker
The automation must count short calls against shares held and refuse any order where short call contracts x 100 > shares held
If it were permitted: never more than a 1x2 ratio, never without a hard upside stop at the short strike
management_rules: If a ratio ever appears accidentally (e.g. shares sold while a covered call remains open), the uncovered call must be bought to close IMMEDIATELY at market, before any other action
exit_rules: Immediate buy-to-close of any uncovered short call detected in the position set, at any time of day, at market
Standing invariant check on every position refresh: short_calls x 100 <= shares_held for every symbol. Any violation triggers an alert and an immediate flatten
assignment_risk: EXTREME. The uncovered call, if assigned, creates a short stock position with unlimited risk in an account not approved to carry it.
buying_power: Naked call margin: roughly 20% of the underlying value minus the OTM amount, plus the premium. Not available at Level 3.
common_mistakes: Creating one accidentally by selling the covering shares and leaving the call open. This is the single most dangerous bookkeeping error in the system.
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
